code.description: The only field a client should branch on.

timezone.description: IANA zone the `time` fields are expressed in.

source.description: app | walk_in | phone — which door it came through.

reason.description: Optional. Free text, for the venue.
REQUIRED. Shown to the diner verbatim.
reason.example: Burst pipe in the kitchen — we are so sorry.

table_released.description: True when the table this booking held is now available again. Released by trg_resv_propagate, which flips reservation_tables.active off for any status outside held|pending|confirmed|seated.

challengeId.description: A challenge that has already been verified

nameAr.description: Arabic name — required, not optional (CLAUDE.md: bilingual by column)

dayOfWeek.description: 0=Sunday. Exactly one of this or specificDate.

defaultTurnMinutes.description: Party-size band → turn minutes. A bare `type: object` here would generate Map<String, dynamic> in the client, so the value type is declared.

isRamadan.description: Flag only — Maghrib anchoring is not implemented yet

spansMidnight.description: Set for sohour-style shifts running past midnight

specificDate.description: Exactly one of this or dayOfWeek.

minCapacity.description: Smallest party this table is offered to

source.description: `app` is rejected — staff entries must stay distinguishable from customer ones

startsAt.description: ISO-8601 UTC. Omit for a party at the door — defaults to now.

registered.description: Always true; the call is an upsert.

is_cover.description: The venue hero. Exactly one per owner.

urls.description: Width in px → public URL. Pick the smallest that fits.

width.description: The ORIGINAL's width, for the aspect box.

identifier.description: Phone number, E.164 or local Egyptian. NOT an email.

deviceToken.description: FCM token to revoke — send it on sign-out

dietary_tags.description: From a fixed vocabulary a CHECK constraint enforces. We mark the exception, never the default — there is no `halal` tag, because in Cairo it is the default and marking it would imply the unmarked dishes are not.

categories.description: Available items only, ordered. A category whose items are all off tonight is omitted rather than sent empty.

pdf_url.description: R-2.3 fallback for a venue whose menu is one scanned file. Composed from the stored key; the client hands it to the phone rather than rendering it.

startsAt.description: The new start, ISO-8601 UTC. Must be in the future.

can_review.description: Whether POST /reviews would accept this visit right now — seated or completed, the table time is over, and not already reviewed. DERIVED ON THE SERVER from the same function the endpoint enforces, so the control the client draws cannot disagree with the answer it gets.

cancelled_by.description: 'user' | 'restaurant' | null. Derived, so no client parses a status string.

code.description: Human-readable, quoted at the door. e.g. SAH-7K2M

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD on the RESTAURANT'S wall clock.

needs_acknowledgement.description: The RESTAURANT cancelled and the diner has not seen it yet. THE CLIENT MUST SURFACE THIS. It is the only signal that a booking they believe they hold is gone, and a reservation carrying it stays in `upcoming` regardless of date until POST /reservations/{id}/acknowledge-cancellation.

review_id.description: The review this visit already has. Null is the common case.

source.description: app | walk_in | phone — which door it came through.

status.description: pending | confirmed | seated | completed | no_show | cancelled_*

time.description: HH:MM on the RESTAURANT'S wall clock.

opens_at.description: HH:MM on the restaurant's wall clock.

specific_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD; null on a weekly row

reason.description: Shown to the owner so they can fix it

deactivated.description: True when it was retired so history survives.

deleted.description: True only when the table had never been used.

reason.description: `not_my_visit` is the one that is about US rather than the reviewer — a review attached to the wrong reservation is a bug in the verified-diner guarantee, not a moderation question.

challengeId.description: The challenge to re-send. The number comes from it.

timezone.description: IANA zone `date` and `time` are expressed in.

images.description: The venue gallery, cover first then by position. Empty for a venue with no photos — which the client draws as a designed empty state, never as a broken image.

timezone.description: IANA zone every wall-clock time here is in.

next_cursor.description: Keyset, not offset — a new review must not shift page two.

author.description: First name and a surname initial ("Nour H."). Never the full name a diner gave at registration.

body.description: Nullable — stars alone is a complete review.

breakdown.description: Star figure → how many gave it. Always all five keys.

rating.description: Computed from the reviews themselves, not from the cached column.

token.description: The token to stop pushing to

saved_at.description: When it was saved. Drives the newest-first order.

cover.description: The venue hero, or null. Fetched for the whole page in ONE query — a search list that asked per row would issue twenty requests over a Cairo mobile connection to render its first screenful.

next_available.description: Local HH:MM teasers. A HINT, not an offer — no absolute instant is given precisely so no client can treat one as bookable.

reservationsOutsideHours.description: Live future bookings now outside the shift. NEVER cancelled — returned so the restaurant can contact those guests.

startsAt.description: Absolute instant, ISO-8601 UTC. POST this back.

time.description: HH:MM on the RESTAURANT'S wall clock.

dayOfWeek.description: 0=Sunday. Exactly one of this or specificDate.

defaultTurnMinutes.description: Party-size band → turn minutes. A bare `type: object` here would generate Map<String, dynamic> in the client, so the value type is declared.

isRamadan.description: Flag only — Maghrib anchoring is not implemented yet

spansMidnight.description: Set for sohour-style shifts running past midnight

specificDate.description: Exactly one of this or dayOfWeek.

active.description: false retires the table; 409 if it has future bookings

offer_expires_at.description: Set only while `offered`. C-3.6 gives a 10-minute claim window, and a CHECK constraint ties the two together in both directions.

window_end.description: And the latest. An offer outside this range is worse than none.

window_start.description: Absolute instant. The earliest the diner will accept.
